name: central-codex-adapter
transport: stdio JSONL (JSON-RPC 2.0, one frame per line)

schemaProvenance.reason: Verified live on 2026-11-11 against installed codex-cli 0.167.1 (Linux x86_64): raw JSON-RPC over app-server stdio on fixture-owned scratch — initialize, thread/start (observed model gpt-6-luna, effort low), turn/start plus turn/completed with result items. Full generate-json-schema capture (47 top-level + 423 v2 files) taken read-only the same day; subset below distills the wire surface Central uses.
schemaProvenance.schemaSource: codex app-server generate-json-schema --experimental (captured 2026-11-11, kept outside the repo)
schemaProvenance.transcriptSource: live probe sessions 2026-11-11 (ephemeral threads, fixture scratch only; transcripts observed in-session, not stored)

policies.oversizeFrame: close transport, require reconciliation, never parse partial event
policies.secretHandling: logs and request errors redact token/secret/authorization material; no tokens or env in durable outbox
policies.modelMismatch: requested/observed model mismatch is a capability error, never silent fallback
policies.usageSource: usage is harvested from thread/tokenUsage/updated notifications, not from turn/completed (which carries no usage field)
